# Format Factory — Execution Method Taxonomy
# Version: 1.0
# Generated by: FORMAT-FACTORY-GOVERNANCE-REPEATABILITY-IDEMPOTENCY-CONTRACTS-001
# Date: 2026-06-08

## Purpose

Every product source mutation must carry an execution_method field in evidence declarations.
This taxonomy defines all valid methods, their allowed status, required evidence, and
repeatability/autonomy claims.

## Classifications

### MANUAL_UNGOVERNED
- Description: Source changed without skill contract, queue item, or bounded file list.
- Production status: REJECTED for new work; LEGACY for pre-taxonomy work only.
- May close product taskcard: NO.
- May claim repeatable: NO. May claim autonomous: NO.
- Needs backfill: YES -> reclassify as BACKFILLED_LEGACY_EXECUTION.
- Validator: FAIL for new work; WARN for legacy.
- Deprecation: DEPRECATED. All new work must use a governed classification.

### MANUAL_GOVERNED_BY_SKILL
- Description: Human or agent implemented source following a .claude/commands/*.md skill contract,
  providing exact files, validation, and skill transcript.
- Production status: ACCEPTED.
- May close product taskcard: YES if transcript and tests present.
- Required evidence: skill_id, skill_version, skill_transcript_path, allowed_files,
  validation_log, source_diff_path, idempotency_key, sidecar or source marker.
- May claim repeatable: DOCUMENTED_ONLY. May claim autonomous: NO.
- Deprecation: Active. Current valid method for governed direct execution.

### LOCAL_GOVERNED_DIRECT_EXECUTION
- Description: Local machine execution via product_action_guard.py / local_deterministic_backend.py,
  dispatched by action queue with PRODUCT_SOURCE_PATCH_BOUNDED.
- Production status: ACCEPTED.
- May close product taskcard: YES if queue item, guard pass, result JSON present.
- Required evidence: action_id, queue_item_id, execution_result_path, before_sha256,
  after_sha256, source_diff_path, idempotency_key, guard_check_pass=true, validation_log.
- May claim repeatable: REPLAYABLE_BY_GOVERNED_AGENT. May claim autonomous: YES.
- Deprecation: Active. Owned by autonomy sprint for maturity improvement.

### AGENT_GOVERNED_DIRECT_EXECUTION
- Description: AI agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Qwen) directly edited source under explicit governance:
  known agent_id, known prompt, declared allowed_files, explicit taskcard.
- Production status: ACCEPTED if all evidence captured.
- May close product taskcard: YES if agent_id, model_id, prompt_artifact_path, diff recorded.
- Required evidence: agent_id, model_id, prompt_artifact_path, allowed_files, touched_files,
  source_diff_path, idempotency_key, validation_log, claim_classification.
- May claim repeatable: REPLAYABLE_BY_GOVERNED_AGENT. May claim autonomous: YES.
- Needs backfill: YES for existing undeclared agent-direct work.

### SKILL_GUIDED_AGENT_EXECUTION
- Description: AI agent invoked a skill contract, followed all steps, recorded transcript.
- Production status: ACCEPTED.
- Required evidence: skill_id, skill_version, agent_id, skill_transcript_path, idempotency_key,
  source_diff_path, validation_log.
- May claim repeatable: REPLAYABLE_BY_GOVERNED_AGENT. May claim autonomous: YES.
- Deprecation: Primary target classification for all new product work.

### QUEUE_DECLARED_EXECUTION
- Description: Queue item exists but execution was NOT dispatched through it — code written
  separately, queue item retroactively updated. Pattern found in autonomous-execution-spine.
- Production status: REJECTED. Claim is INVALID.
- May close product taskcard: NO.
- Needs backfill: YES -> reclassify immediately.
- Validator: FAIL if queue item exists but no execution telemetry (result JSON) found.
- Deprecation: DEPRECATED IMMEDIATELY. Never use.

### QUEUE_DISPATCHED_EXECUTION
- Description: Queue item dispatched through local_deterministic_backend or equivalent,
  execution result JSON captured, diff recorded.
- Production status: ACCEPTED.
- Required evidence: action_id, result_json_path, guard_check_pass, before_sha256,
  after_sha256, source_diff_path, idempotency_key.
- May claim repeatable: REPLAYABLE_BY_QUEUE_OR_BACKEND. May claim autonomous: YES.
- Deprecation: Active. Goal classification for autonomy sprint.

### GENERATED_PATCH_EXECUTION
- Description: Deterministic patch generated from spec/template and applied to source.
- Production status: ACCEPTED.
- Required evidence: patch_file_path, patch_sha256, generation_inputs_path, apply_command,
  idempotency_key, validation_log.
- May claim repeatable: REPLAYABLE_BY_QUEUE_OR_BACKEND. May claim autonomous: YES.
- Deprecation: Not yet implemented. Future target.

### REPLAYED_PATCH_EXECUTION
- Description: Previously recorded patch replayed; produced no-op or equivalent diff.
- Production status: ACCEPTED.
- Required evidence: original_patch_path, replay_run_log, replay_result (NO_OP or EQUIVALENT_DIFF).
- May claim repeatable: REPLAYED_AND_PROVEN. May claim autonomous: YES.
- Deprecation: Not yet implemented. Future target.

### BACKFILLED_LEGACY_EXECUTION
- Description: Work performed before this taxonomy. Cannot be replayed from original inputs.
  Functionality accepted; repeatability claims prohibited.
- Production status: ACCEPTED for functionality; REJECTED for repeatability claims.
- Required evidence: sidecar attribution file, claim_classification=LEGACY_BACKFILLED, tests pass.
- May claim repeatable: NO. Must use WORKS_BUT_NOT_REPEATABLE.
- May claim autonomous: NO.

### UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_METHOD
- Description: Work done, no method recorded. Source changed without attribution.
- Production status: REJECTED. Must be investigated and reclassified.
- May close product taskcard: NO.
- Validator: CRITICAL FAIL. Blocks sprint acceptance.
- Deprecation: DEPRECATED IMMEDIATELY.

## Hard Rules
1. MANUAL_UNGOVERNED and UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_METHOD MUST NEVER close a product source taskcard.
2. No work may claim REPLAYABLE without a replay_recipe_path or patch_file_path artifact.
3. QUEUE_DECLARED_EXECUTION is immediately invalid and deprecated.
4. execution_method is NEVER optional in evidence declarations from the next sprint forward.
5. Pre-taxonomy work must use BACKFILLED_LEGACY_EXECUTION.
